walk_fixes.reported: founder, walking items 2-8: "when i try to search, creators it self masked under key pad ... all the screen is covered with header things ... if we come to creator visibility screen, it is almost nothing ... this happened in many places."
walk_fixes.cause: DiscoverList pinned FOUR stacked bands above the list and none of them scrolled — the caller's hint, the search box, the filter chips, and the count/sort row. On a 6-inch phone exactly one creator card fitted; opening the keyboard (adjustResize, which is correct) left none. Because DiscoverList is shared, the same waste appeared on Discover and in the group screens — the "many places" the founder named.
walk_fixes.fix: only the two controls a person actually touches stay pinned (search, filters). The hint and the count/sort ride in ListHeaderComponent, so they are there when you arrive and scroll away once you are looking at people. Added keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled" so a creator can be tapped without dismissing the keyboard first, and keyboardDismissMode="on-drag". About 100px returned permanently, on every screen that uses the list.
